function narrowed(x: number | string) {
  if (typeof x === 'number') x += 'x';
}
function field(o: {v: number | string}) {
  if (typeof o.v === 'number') o.v += 'x';
  if (typeof o['v'] === 'number') o['v'] += 'x';
}
function fieldLiteral(o: {v: 1 | 2; w: 1 | 2}) {
  o.v += 3;
  o['w'] *= 3;
}
class WiderSetter {
  get value(): number { return 1; }
  set value(input: number | string) { void input; }
}
class NarrowerSetter {
  get value(): number | string { return 1; }
  set value(input: number) { void input; }
}
let wide = new WiderSetter();
wide.value += 'x';
wide['value'] += 'x';
let narrow = new NarrowerSetter();
narrow.value += 'x';
narrow['value'] += 'x';

class Accessor {
  get value(): number | string { return Math.abs(1); }
  set value(input: number | string | boolean) { void input; }
}
function dot(a: Accessor) {
  if (typeof a.value === 'number') a.value += 'x';
}
function index(a: Accessor) {
  if (typeof a['value'] === 'number') a['value'] += 'x';
}
class NarrowAccessor {
  get value(): number | string { return Math.abs(1); }
  set value(input: number) { void input; }
}
function narrowDot(a: NarrowAccessor) {
  if (typeof a.value === 'string') a.value += 'x';
}
function narrowIndex(a: NarrowAccessor) {
  if (typeof a['value'] === 'string') a['value'] += 'x';
}
function signed(a: Accessor) {
  if (typeof a.value === 'number') (a.value) += 'x';
}
